spans.quote: Sit and let attention rest on the whole body at once: not one part, the whole field of sensation.
Then take the body, and the world around it, as made of awareness.

attention.note: the body and the world around it: the light widened around the figure

spans.quote: Let this be felt rather than thought.
When the mind narrows back to "me" and "mine", return to the wider field and rest there.
The body stays where it is; only the sense of it being separate softens.
